device: Apple Silicon Mac, Chrome and Safari 26 or newer (desktop A in the device matrix); tier desktop at 60 fps

steps.instruction: In Chrome open <preview>/?perf=1 (no ?tier=, so the benchmark picks the tier). Note the tier the HUD shows and the backend (expected webgpu). Tap Export and save notes.json to docs/device-spike/M01c/mac/chrome/. Copy 'signals' into tools/ci/fixtures/ua/desktop-chrome.json (synthetic false, keep expect).
Open <preview>/?perf=1&tier=desktop and tap 'Run 10 min'. Tap Export and save perf.json to docs/device-spike/M01c/mac/chrome/.

In Safari open <preview>/?perf=1. Note the tier and the backend (WebGPU in Safari 26). Tap Export and save notes.json to docs/device-spike/M01c/mac/safari/. Copy 'signals' into tools/ci/fixtures/ua/desktop-safari.json (synthetic false, keep expect).
In both browsers open <preview>/?perf=1&gl=1&tier=desktop: the backend must read webgl2. Record it.

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-spike/M01c/mac/chrome/perf.json --tier desktop --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M01c-mac.json and pnpm check:unit -- packages/shared (the captured fixtures must still pass AC-2). Record adapter.info (vendor, architecture, description) for both browsers in the report.
